Question Choices: In a signed-number model, a robot removes 3 tokens, each worth −15 points. Fill in the blanks: The change is −3 × ___, so the total score change is ___ points.
Solution: The removed total is 3 × (−15) = −45. Removing it changes the score by −(−45) = +45. Thus the blanks are −15, 45.

Question Choices: A motion model has a constant vertical rate of −7 meters per interval, with upward positive. Trace the motion backward 3 intervals (a time change of −3 intervals). How much higher was the earlier position? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Use signed change = signed rate × signed time change. Tracing backward gives a negative time change.
Solution: The time change is −3 intervals. Vertical change = (−7) × (−3) = 21 meters. The earlier position is 21 meters higher; this traces recorded motion backward.
